annotations.title: Get a link to continue on the website

description: A link the signed-in customer clicks to continue on the firm's website, already signed in: "payment" to pay (after choosing packages), "verification" for identity verification, "signing" to sign documents, "documents" to upload a switch-in's documents. Payment, ID documents and signatures never go through chat.
